answer: Cross-custody shard ring: enrolment splits a signing key into five Shamir shards held by unrelated custodians, so no single card exists. Minting needs any three shards plus a live challenge filmed against the day's basalt-etched nonce, and clones starve without quorum. Duplicity caught by the set burns every custodian's 0.5 ETH bond. Attacker cost is fixed: 2.5 ETH plus five coerced custodians and ~90 minutes of setup apiece, so 1,000 sybils runs 2,500 ETH. An identity is a cedar door with five locks; stamping fake keys earns you a terrace of strangers, not entry.
